soste.title: The Great Mosque gives way to the Cathedral (1434)
The Giralda gets its Renaissance belfry (1568)
Isabel II Bridge replaces the boat bridge (1845-1852)
Plaza de España for the 1929 Expo (1914-1929)
The river is moved west: Corta de la Cartuja (1975-1982)

didascalie.title: Ferdinand III takes Seville
didascalie.line: After a 15-month siege the Almohad city surrenders to Castile.

didascalie.title: Earthquake
didascalie.line: The Giralda's four golden spheres fall.

didascalie.title: A Christian crown
didascalie.line: A cross and a bell replace the minaret top.

didascalie.title: The Inquisition arrives
didascalie.line: Its first Castilian tribunal sits in Triana Castle.

didascalie.title: A new top for the Giralda
didascalie.line: Hernán Ruiz adds the Renaissance belfry: ~100 m.

didascalie.title: Peak of the Golden Age
didascalie.line: About 120,000 people: one of Europe's largest cities.

didascalie.title: Royal Tobacco Factory
didascalie.line: Work starts on one of the largest industrial buildings in Europe.

didascalie.title: Disentailment
didascalie.line: Church property is sold off; convents are emptied.

didascalie.title: Plaza Nueva
didascalie.line: The San Francisco convent is replaced by a square.

didascalie.title: Isabel II Bridge opens
didascalie.line: The first fixed bridge to Triana ends 600 years of boats.

didascalie.title: The walls come down
didascalie.line: Gates and walls give way to boulevards; Macarena survives.

didascalie.title: 134,000 people
didascalie.line: The city finally grows beyond its medieval size.

didascalie.title: 148,000 people
didascalie.line: The first districts grow outside the old walls.

didascalie.title: Ibero-American Exposition
didascalie.line: Plaza de España and María Luisa Park open.

didascalie.title: 312,000 people
didascalie.line: The city doubles in twenty years.

didascalie.title: Chapina is closed
didascalie.line: The old river arm is dammed; the city side becomes a dock.

didascalie.title: Los Remedios
didascalie.line: A new district rises on the old Tablada fields.

didascalie.title: 548,000 people
didascalie.line: High-rise blocks spread east and south.

didascalie.title: Corta de la Cartuja
didascalie.line: The river is diverted west of La Cartuja against floods.

didascalie.title: 654,000 people
didascalie.line: Thirty years of record growth.

didascalie.title: Expo works
didascalie.line: New bridges and the Cartuja site take shape.

didascalie.title: Santa Justa station
didascalie.line: The new railway station opens.

didascalie.title: Isla Mágica
didascalie.line: A theme park opens on the old Expo grounds.

didascalie.title: 684,000 people
didascalie.line: Growth moves to the suburbs.

didascalie.title: Metropol Parasol
didascalie.line: A wooden canopy over the Encarnación square.

didascalie.title: Las Setas open
didascalie.line: The "mushrooms" become a city symbol.

didascalie.title: Seville today
didascalie.line: ~690,000 people.

didascalie.title: 800 years of Seville
didascalie.line: From Almohad city to Expo 92.
